**Organization**: Public-Vinyl-Radio (GitHub org hosting this repo's remote)

**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Secrets management**: 1Password CLI (`op`) used in shell history; CI secrets referenced by name only: CODECOV_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, RELEASE_PLEASE_TOKEN

**Default / protected branches**: main (default); rulesets active: `protect main`, `protect semver tags`, `tag ruleset` — treat main and semver tags as protected even though no classic branch-protection rule is listed

**CI/CD deploy targets**: ghcr.io/public-vinyl-radio/* (docker-publish.yml); deploy via `just deploy vX.Y.Z` / `just deploy-rc`; deploy scripts present at my-collection-search/scripts/deploy-prod.sh and deploy-prod-localbuild.sh
**Network posture**: None configured
**Host containment**: None configured — assume Claude Code runs on an ordinary developer machine with open internet
**Source control**: The trusted repo (Public-Vinyl-Radio/groovenet) and its origin remote only (no additional orgs configured)
**Trusted internal domains**: None configured
**Trusted cloud buckets**: None configured
**Key internal services**: None configured
**Internal package registry**: None configured — public npm registry and ghcr.io/public-vinyl-radio/* are the only package/image destinations seen

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: .env, .env.*, .envrc and similar gitignored files (DB credentials, OPENAI_API_KEY, APPLE_MUSIC_PRIVATE_KEY, DISCOGS_USER_TOKEN, YOUTUBE_API_KEY, RESTIC_PASSWORD, B2_ACCOUNT_KEY, POSTHOG_KEY); AuthKey* files; CI secrets CODECOV_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN/RELEASE_PLEASE_TOKEN; share only with audiences cleared at the [named+specifics] bar
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured

**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace/host/container with `prod` or `production` as a whole word/segment — includes my-collection-search/scripts/deploy-prod.sh, deploy-prod-localbuild.sh, docker-compose.prod.yml, and `just deploy` production targets
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: production deploys via `just deploy` / docker-compose.prod.yml; None further configured — fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
### User-specific
**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development (GrooveNet vinyl collection manager — Next.js/Postgres app plus Python services)

**Trusted repo**: Public-Vinyl-Radio/groovenet (this working directory, worktree at /Users/saegey/.herdr/worktrees/dj-playlist/bug-459-database-backup-fix) and its origin remote — PUBLIC, so only this repo's own work belongs there; confidential/secret material is never cleared into it regardless of visibility

**Org-specific CLIs**: `groovenet` CLI (talks to user's collection over HTTP, reads config from ~/.groovenet/config.json — no credentials belong in commands); `just` as the command surface (prefer over raw `docker compose`); `gh` for GitHub issue/PR work in this repo
